description: Cloud-hosted MCP server for zero-friction CacheBash adoption

userStories.title: Initialize Cloud Run project structure
userStories.description: Create cloud-run/ directory with Dockerfile, package.json, tsconfig.json, and src/ structure

userStories.title: Implement health check endpoint
userStories.description: Add GET /v1/health endpoint returning { status: 'ok', version: '1.0.0' }

userStories.title: Implement authentication middleware
userStories.description: Validate API key from Authorization header against Firestore hashed keys
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts valid API keys and attaches userId to request

userStories.title: Implement SSE endpoint base
userStories.description: Create GET /v1/sse endpoint with SSE connection handling

userStories.title: Implement MCP protocol over SSE
userStories.description: Handle MCP tool calls (ask_question, get_response, update_status, pin_task, resume_task) via SSE
acceptanceCriteria: All 5 MCP tools work via SSE
Error handling with proper MCP error format

userStories.title: Implement rate limiting middleware
userStories.description: Add per-API-key rate limits: SSE 2 concurrent, ask_question 100/hr, get_response 500/hr, update_status 200/hr

userStories.title: Implement input validation
userStories.description: Validate all inputs: question 2000 chars, context 500 chars, status 200 chars, options max 5 x 100 chars

userStories.title: Add structured logging
userStories.description: Replace console.log with structured JSON logging including userId, action, duration_ms

userStories.title: Implement graceful shutdown
userStories.description: Handle SIGTERM: send server-restarting event to SSE clients, wait 5s, close connections

userStories.title: Update Flutter app API key screen
userStories.description: Show cloud MCP config snippet with https://mcp.cachebash.app/v1/sse URL

userStories.title: Add Test Connection button to app
userStories.description: Add button that tests SSE connection to cloud server and shows success/failure
acceptanceCriteria: Button visible on API key screen

userStories.title: Write unit tests for Cloud Run
userStories.description: Add Jest tests for auth, rate limiting, validation, and MCP protocol

userStories.title: Deploy to Cloud Run
userStories.description: Deploy container to GCP Cloud Run, verify health endpoint accessible

userStories.title: Add Projects feature to organize questions
userStories.description: Create Projects (or Sprints) to group related questions. Each MCP session can specify a project. Questions are organized by project in the app UI.
acceptanceCriteria: MCP tools accept optional projectId parameter
App shows project list with question counts
Questions grouped by project in UI
Default 'Uncategorized' project for questions without projectId

userStories.title: Add archive functionality for questions
userStories.description: Allow users to archive questions they've dealt with. Archived questions hidden by default but viewable.
acceptanceCriteria: Archive button on question detail screen
Archived questions have archived: true field
Main list hides archived by default

userStories.title: Add delete functionality for questions and projects
userStories.description: Allow permanent deletion of questions and projects. Soft delete with 30-day recovery period.
acceptanceCriteria: Deleted items hidden from all views
Cloud Function to permanently delete after 30 days
Delete project also archives its questions

userStories.title: Add project management screen
userStories.description: Screen to create, rename, and delete projects. Set active project for new questions.
acceptanceCriteria: Project list screen accessible from home
Set default project for new questions
